content.text: I fixed this by editing only `solution/core.py`, and the visible test suite now passes (1 passed). The cause was an off-by-one in `TTLCache._expired`. It checked `clock() - ts > ttl`, so an entry still counted as live at the exact moment its TTL ran out. I changed it to `>=`, so an entry is valid from insertion up to, but not including, `inserted_at + ttl`. Because `get`, `_purge` and the eviction logic all use `_expired`, they now agree on that boundary. I also made two related changes that the visible test doesn't check. `put` now clears out expired entries before evicting the least-recently-used one, so dead entries can no longer pile up beyond capacity. And `len()` now clears out expired entries first, so it counts only live ones; before, expired entries were included in the count. The public `TTLCache` API is unchanged.
